WITH youngest_win AS (
  SELECT winner_name, winner_rank, winner_age,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY winner_id ORDER BY winner_age ASC, tourney_date ASC, match_num ASC) AS rn
  FROM matches
  WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT winner_name, winner_rank
FROM youngest_win
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY winner_age ASC
LIMIT 5;
